corrections.impact: Original artifact preserved. Shoulder frozen reversal coefficient is zero, so its original numerical predictions are unchanged. Any refit must be labeled a new model after held-out data.

ordering_method: Filesystem recording-creation timestamp anchors each relative event timestamp; recorded MCU milliseconds accompany each event and corroborate order where monotonic. MCU timestamps reset on reboot. Filenames never determine direction history.
limitations: Recordings omit absolute wall-clock event timestamps and boot IDs. Filesystem creation metadata supplies cross-boot order and is explicitly retained; it is weaker evidence than logged absolute timestamps.
No recording audit proves absence of unrecorded physical intervention or manually moved joints. Unknown passive motion invalidates assumed command history until another observed commanded movement.
Direction after zero issued pulses is not treated as physical direction history.
